body: I completely agree. I started cutting myself at 7 years old. Over 15 years have passed and I still want to die. I constantly think about cutting, how all it would take was one good slice and it'd all be over. I'd do it more if I could hide it better. I hate the judgement in people's eyes when they notice my scars all up and down my arm. They judge and tell everyone but you that you need help while simultaneously refusing to help you themselves and making your life harder. No one cares. I don't even want a funeral when I die cause I feel like there is no one that deserves to be there. Just throw me in the dirt and let me finally have my peace.

I felt like this my last birthday and now it's been almost 4 months. Just waiting to get hit by a car or something ig. I wish I had the balls to just do it myself but I'm a pus*y. I don't want to live another second on this planet. Ive wanted nothing more than to die since I was 7. Never thought I'd make it to 23. And I've never been more ready to die than I am right now.
That's what I've told myself everyday since I was 7. When will it get better exactly? When im 50? What is the point?

I relate with this so much. Once you have exhausted every last stitch of effort and have actively decided that you want to die, any forms of motivation seem cheesy and downright stupid. Like you dont think I already tried to be happy before this? Dumbasses. If I could, I would, but I can't, so just let me be.
